chunks: Then he went back to his people, strutting.

key_terms.يَتَمَطَّى: to strut or walk with exaggerated pride and arrogance

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'yatamatta' (strutting) signify in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase vividly captures the 'self-satisfied' or 'strutting' gait of the arrogant, often linked to Abu Jahl or the general disbelievers of Mecca, illustrating how physical demeanor reflects inner spiritual decay. It serves as a critique of social pride, contrasting the haughty walk of the wicked with the humble composure of the righteous, a theme emphasized by scholars like Al-Tabarsi and Al-Kulayni in their discussions on character ethics.
